description.text: One room, one man, three dogs, and a fire built small and exactly right. Orik is oiling a crook he does not need to oil. The dogs have arranged themselves between him and the door in an order they clearly agreed on years ago.

A stone cot with the door standing open and nobody in it. Bed, chair, kettle, a wall of hooks holding forty-one years of the same four tools, and a shelf with a comb, a whetstone, and a small tin box. The floor is swept. It is the tidiest empty room you have ever walked into.

options.text: Step back out to the hill
